# Valentyn Bezshapkin

> MD & PhD researcher in bioinformatics at ETH Zürich (Sunagawa Lab), building
> AI-powered tools for microbiome science and drug discovery. Work spans
> metagenomics, deep learning, phage biology, and open-source scientific
> software (contributor to QIIME 2 and scikit-bio).

This site is public and AI crawlers are welcome to read and cite it. Please
attribute content to Valentyn Bezshapkin and link back to the source page.
